ai_summary: Here is a 2-3 sentence executive summary of the financial document:  Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited's (ABFRL) monitoring agency reports for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, confirm no material variation or deviation in the utilization of proceeds from its Rights Issue (Rs. 995.12 Cr) and Preferential Issue (Rs. 2,378.75 Cr), as verified by Axis Bank and ICRA Limited, respectively. Funds were fully deployed as intended for debt repayment, capital expenditure, and general corporate purposes, reflecting strong adherence to investor commitments and sound financial governance with no red flags identified.
